evs.text: Long ago, on the Island of Sounds, there grew a magic World Flower.  ‹film_1›
Every petal was a sound. With sounds, we could talk, and read, and sing!  ‹film_2›
Words, words, WORDS! How I HATE them!  ‹film_3›
I am Baron Muddle! Every sound on this island is MINE! Mwa-ha-ha-ha!  ‹film_4›
Oh no! The petals blew away, all over the island!  ‹film_5›
The World Flower has gone dark. Now nobody can read!  ‹film_6›
We need a hero. We need... a Super Ninja!  ‹film_7›
Win back every petal, one sound at a time!  ‹film_8›
I am Sensei Maple. I will train you. Now, choose your ninja!  ‹intro_8›
Great choice! Let's rescue those sounds!  ‹chose›
Do you go to big school yet?  ‹fm_opt_q1›
I've set up the game for Year One, with new ways to spell the sounds you know!  ‹fm_opt_ok_y1›
Your grown-ups can change this later, in the grown-ups' settings.  ‹fm_opt_grownups›
Ninja training! First, tap the big gong!  ‹tut_1›
Stuck? Tap me, down here in the corner. Try it now!  ‹fm_help_short›
That's it! I'm always here to help.  ‹fm_help_ok›
And when you tap the speaker, I'll say it again!  ‹fm_speaker›
And when you tap the speaker, I'll say it again!  ‹fm_speaker›
This is the dojo. A dojo is where ninjas practise! Let's practise some sounds.  ‹dojo_hello›
We hear the sound. Now look: this is how we spell it.  ‹audit_hear_see›
It's two letters, but it's one sound.  ‹t_two_letters›
Tap it, and say it with me!  ‹dojo_tap_say›
And this is how we spell it.  ‹audit_spell_it›
Ooh! You already know this sound. Here's another way to spell it! Same sound, different spelling.  ‹same_sound_new›
It's two letters, but it's one sound.  ‹t_two_letters›
Tap it, and say it with me!  ‹dojo_tap_say›
Three right answers in a row! Your ninja is getting stronger.  ‹audit_streak_first›
Now let's make words! First, listen to the word. Then tap its sounds, one at a time.  ‹dojo_build›
Look, a gem! Each gem holds a way to spell a sound. When you get words right, it fills up.  ‹audit_gem_first›
It's two letters, but it's one sound.  ‹t_two_letters›
Well done! You practised so hard!  ‹dojo_done›
Look! Your pictures are turning into stickers!  ‹fm_rw_look›
Every picture you play with becomes a sticker!  ‹fm_rw_every›
You know this sound! Now let's look at the different ways we spell it.  ‹audit_bridging_first›
Sorting time! These words have the same sound, but it's spelt in different ways.  ‹audit_sort_first›
This sound can be spelt in two ways.  ‹audit_sort_pair›
It's two letters, but it's one sound.  ‹t_two_letters›
It's two letters, but it's one sound.  ‹t_two_letters›
Tap the chest with the same spelling as the word.  ‹help_sort›
Your Sticker Book lives here, on the map!  ‹fm_rw2_map›
Tap the glowing stone to start your next adventure.  ‹map_hint›
